技术与研究.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
技术与研究.snippet: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.
